verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build system, and a tool of this kind could plausibly offer AI-generated suggestions about configs or builds, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows any AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Its documented capabilities are reproducible environments, rollbacks, builds and CLI commands such as search and why-depends, none of which are AI-driven.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
